window_policies.aggregation: mean of two frozen last-hidden-state vectors

fit_policy: Reuse exact old validation-selected probe parameters and thresholds. No refitting, recalibration, selection or exclusions based on new outcomes.
loss: NLL on old train-defined T2 classes; mean loss over seeds, never probability ensemble. Negative contrasts favor first policy/pretraining interaction.

inference.unit: date; jointly resample all stocks, anchors and seeds for a date
inference.aggregation: Equal-weight symbols within a date; equal-weight dates. Seed-averaged per-anchor loss first.
inference.primary: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of dates; block length 2; percentile 95% interval; centered two-sided approximate p-values; Holm across three primary contrasts
inference.sensitivity: IID date bootstrap and leave-one-date-out; limited to ten dates, conditional on frozen fitted models; no refitting uncertainty

quality: Reuse original cleaner/clock_session; retain numeric stats and inclusive sale conditions. Reconstruct exact timestamp as microsecond time_m plus time_m_nano (last three digits), matching the original ZIP nanosecond timestamp precision. New equal-timestamp source-row order is deterministic by source, sequence, exchange and trade ID; it does not infer exchange-wide causal order. Require every declared date-symbol session.
information_cutoff: All input windows end at or before anchor. Labels remain original T2; original shared-task future-VWAP availability screen retained and disclosed.
source_scope: Fresh rows for this TAQ study, but historical dates overlap the calendar range used by other projects. This is a prospective protocol on retrospectively obtained data, not a preregistered or globally untouched dataset.

schema_amendment_before_new_outcomes.reason: Original ZIP header/sample confirms nanosecond TIME_M strings; WRDS SQL separates microseconds and nanosecond remainder. Fix precision before fetching targets.

null_condition_implementation_fix_before.reason: Initial extraction omitted SQL NULL sale-condition values. Original CSV loader maps missing fields to empty strings, which are eligible. Use COALESCE in SQL to exactly reproduce that rule; preserve all symbols/dates and original literal sale-condition eligibility. Initial incomplete files are replaced, no new model outputs have been computed.
